title: Majority quorum tolerance by voter count
method: Synthetic majority arithmetic for stable membership: quorum = floor(N/2)+1 and tolerated unavailable voters = N-quorum. Three and four voters tolerate one unavailable voter; five tolerate two. Surviving voters must communicate and retain valid state; this is not an availability forecast.
alt: Majority quorum tolerance by voter count. 3 voters: 1 unavailable voters tolerated; 4 voters: 1 unavailable voters tolerated; 5 voters: 2 unavailable voters tolerated. Illustrative values.
